coverage_summary: Weakest modern stop: the vendor 4-view (dims printed) is ~3% off in WB/L; plus Autocar-type top/side and a cutaway. Scale every 964 drawing by the official wheelbase (2272 mm) and check overhangs against geometry.json.

blueprints.license_notes: Watermarked PREVIEW of a paid the-blueprints.com vector drawing (the vector itself was NOT bought). The preview is freely viewable on the product page. Reference only; watermark crosses the drawing; dimensions printed on it are the vendor's.
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Manual reading: hubs ~227/~610 px, extremes 72-808 px -> 0.518 vs printed 0.531 (-2.4%, low-res). Wikipedia 964: wheelbase 2270, length 4275 mm https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_911_(964) - see geometry.json for Porsche figures.
blueprints.ratio_check_vs_official: measured WB/L 0.518 vs official 2272/4250 mm = 0.535 -> -3.1% : DISAGREES (>2%) - scale by wheelbase and check overhangs

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
